2.1.description: AlertPolicy is the single decision authority; the three old decision sites (corroborator._determine_alert_status, state_machine._determine_action, harness._action_for_urgency) are deleted or delegate.

2.2.description: Corroboration removed; no source-count gate may suppress/delay. Remove the full surface: both YAML keys, both Pydantic fields, and the tests/conftest.py key — config still loads cleanly with no dead field.

2.3.description: Dedup is the only suppressor of alert-eligible events (urgency >= notify threshold): no-alert ONLY when relation==SAME on an already-alerted event. NONE-band (<=4) is banding via 2.4, not suppression.

2.4.description: Three bands (rubric v2): >=call-tier (9-10) -> CALL; 5-8 -> NOTIFY; <=4 -> NONE (classification persisted and logged, no alert). Boundaries config-driven.

2.5.description: GeoWeighter computes geo_tier (HIGH if target in high_tier_countries OR target==RU & attacker_is_nato; LOW for inside-UA/interior-MD); CALL requires urgency>=tier AND geo HIGH; urgency>=call-tier with geo LOW demotes to NOTIFY, never NONE.

2.5a.description: UNKNOWN geo at urgency>=9 treated as HIGH (fail toward firing).

2.5b.description: kinetic derived deterministically from event_type against config-driven geography.kinetic_event_types (not an LLM field, not hardcoded); default set MUST NOT include debris_found or official_statement; single definition consumed by 2.5/2.11 and 3.8.

2.6.description: NEW at CALL tier fires a call. ESCALATION/UPDATE to an event already alerted at CALL class uses NOTIFY, not a second call. An event's FIRST CALL-class intent MUST fire regardless of relation. 'Alerted at CALL class' = a CALL intent was DISPATCHED, regardless of transport outcome.

2.7.description: Decision is channel-agnostic; AlertIntent carries a channel class; transports pluggable and preserved.

2.8.description: All thresholds + geography membership in config; none hardcoded.

2.9.description: AlertPolicy.decide is a pure no-I/O function of EventDecision, weighted urgency, geo_tier, and the event's prior alert class (already_alerted_at: ChannelClass|None).

2.10.description: Defines EventDecision contract (relation NEW|SAME|ESCALATION + matched_event_id) as the Phase 3 interface.

2.11.description: Poland-only kinetic floor: kinetic (2.5b) + target==PL -> urgency floored >=9; MUST NOT floor other HIGH-tier countries; debris-recovery reports never floored; config geography.floor_countries default [PL].

2.12.description: AlertPolicy band mapping reproduces the owner's action from the owner's urgency for all 60 labeled events in tests/fixtures/dedup_traps.yaml (call->CALL, sms->NOTIFY, none->NONE). Zero mismatches allowed.

2.13.description: Pre-dedup event-creation gate becomes config-driven (dedup.min_event_urgency) and MUST NOT drop official_statement/roundup stories reaching the notify band; the is_military_event drop MUST NOT apply to debris_found/official_statement articles; NONE-band articles keep persisted classification, no event row.

2.14.description: Every classifier event_type value (incl. debris_found, official_statement) has a Polish rendering in alert templates — alerts are in Polish, no raw English token fallback.
